title: 第343章 局面混乱
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

韩林侧目望去，只见柳三春正从人群中向自己走来，眼帘微微一垂后就迎了上去。

“怎么了？”

“你不是想知道撼地猿消息吗，我刚给你打听到了。”柳三春笑着传音。

“哦？”

韩林心中一喜，“在哪？”

“不是撼地猿，是撼地猿骨，我刚帮你问了一下，说是宋云启三年前在火云禁地内猎杀过一只撼地猿，并带走了尸体，你可以去找他问问看，那尸体还在不在！”柳三春传音道。

“宋云启？”韩林满心困惑道。

“就是碧空城‘玄炼坊’的老板！他是有名的炼器师，我估计他拿撼地猿骨是为了炼器用的，不过据说那撼地猿尸体十分庞大，估计他也用不完，你可以去碰碰运气。”柳三春解释道。

“明白了！”

韩林恍然地点了下头，眼珠微转几下道：“此人人品如何？跟各大家族有什么牵连吗？”

“人品就不好说了，与各大家族基本上是生意上的往来，没听说跟哪家关系特别好的！”

“好，那我有时间去看看！多谢柳道友告知此事了。”韩林真心感激道。

“哈哈，不用客气，以后若有时间不妨到柳家坐坐，我们真没你想的那么阴险。”

“呃，行，有时间我一定前来拜访！”韩林尴尬一笑。

“嘿嘿，那我就先走一步了，韩兄你也赶紧离开吧，这里人多眼杂，要是被人发现端倪可就不好了。”

柳三春一拱手，就转身离去。

“这家伙看起来倒也值得一交，再看看吧，若是合适，韩某就认了你这个朋友。”韩林望着柳三春背影暗自想了句，随即也转身走向一面山崖，准备离开此地。

而就在此时，忽然一道道身影，从山顶核心位置腾空而起，转瞬间就在半空中围成一圈，将整座聚元山包围了起来，让原本准备离开的众人纷纷脸色一变。

“赵家的筑基强者？他们想干什么。”

“不太妙，看他们一个个冰冷着脸，怕是这次在秘境里面折损的人太多，准备找人算账的！”

“这不仗势欺人吗！”

“嘘，小声点，我们又没杀赵家的人，怕什么，难道他们还敢屠戮无辜不成！”

“……”

随着赵家十一名筑基强者升空，聚元山顿时变得跟菜市场一样，吵闹之声此起彼伏。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Han Lin looked sideways and saw Liu Sanchun walking towards him from the crowd. He lowered his eyes slightly before approaching him.

"What's wrong?"

"Don't you want to know about the Earthshaker? I just asked you about it." Liu Sanchun smiled and sent the message.

"Oh?"

Han Lin was delighted, "Where is it?"

"It's not the Earth-shaking ape, it's the Earth-shaking ape bones. I just asked for you. It was said that Song Yunqi hunted an Earth-shaking ape in the Fire Cloud Forbidden Area three years ago and took away the body. You can go to him and ask if the body is still there!" Liu Sanchun said in a voice message.

"Song Yunqi?" Han Lin asked with confusion.

"He is the boss of the 'Xuan Lian Fang' in Blue Sky City! He is a famous weapon refiner. I guess he took the bones of the Earth-Shaking Ape for the purpose of refining weapons. However, it is said that the body of the Earth-shaking Ape is very large, and I guess he won't be able to use it all. You can try your luck." Liu Sanchun explained.

"Got it!"

Han Lin nodded suddenly, rolled his eyes slightly and said, "What is this person's character like? Does he have any involvement with any major families?"

"It's hard to say about my character. I basically have business dealings with all the major families. I haven't heard of any one I have a particularly good relationship with!"

"Okay, then I'll have time to take a look! Thank you, Fellow Daoist Liu, for informing me about this." Han Lin said with sincere gratitude.

"Haha, you're welcome. If you have time in the future, you might as well stop by Liu's house. We are really not as sinister as you think."

"Uh, okay, I will definitely come and visit when I have time!" Han Lin smiled awkwardly.

"Hehe, I will take the first step. Brother Han, please leave quickly. There are many people here and it will be bad if someone finds out."

Liu Sanchun handed over his hand and turned around to leave.

"This guy seems to be worth making friends with. Let's take another look. If it's suitable, Han will recognize you as a friend." Han Lin looked at Liu Sanchun's back and thought to himself, then turned and walked towards a cliff, preparing to leave here.

At this moment, figures suddenly rose into the air from the core of the mountain top and formed a circle in mid-air, surrounding the entire Juyuan Mountain. The expressions of everyone who had been preparing to leave changed.

"The foundation-building experts of the Zhao family? What do they want to do?"

"It's not good. Looking at them all with cold faces, I'm afraid too many people have been lost in the secret realm this time, so I'm going to find someone to settle the score!"

"Isn't this bullying others?"

"Shh, keep your voice down. We didn't kill anyone from the Zhao family. What are we afraid of? Do they still dare to kill innocent people?"

"..."

As the eleven foundation-building experts of the Zhao family took off, Juyuan Mountain suddenly became like a vegetable market, with noisy sounds coming and going.
